signals.summary: arXiv:2611.12940v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement Learning has achieved tremendous success in recent years. Extending its scope from the traditional complex games such as Atari, Go, Pokeman, and Chess, reinforcement learning has caught researchers' attention on modelling real-life scenarios. Personalized medicine and the dynamic treatment regimen are two such preliminary research fields; researchers are focusing their mindsets currently. Estimating the optimal dynamic treatment regimens from the observational real clinical data is being popularized among the researchers, widening its scope towards more advanced versions of reinforcement learning algorithms. This research is about a research study that focused on reinforcement learning techniques that have been approached in the context of cancer chemotherapy treatments. Primarily this thesis addresses the result of the study by means of the state-of-the-art on reinforcement learning techniques used in generating the optimal policy for sequential treatments, including the existing online reinforcement learning approaches. signals.title: Tabular Foundation Models vs Tuned Gradient Boosting for Telecom Churn: A Profit- and Calibration-Aware Evaluation
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.12942v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict from a labelled context in a single forward pass. A recent benchmark reported that they decisively outperform tree ensembles for customer churn, but it compared them with untuned gradient-boosted trees (GBDTs) and scored only ranking metrics, while a retention campaign is judged in money. We re-evaluate TabPFN-2.5, TabPFN-3.5, TabPFN-3.5-Fast and TabICL v2 against Optuna-tuned GBDTs on five public telecom churn datasets over 10 seeded splits. We separate three questions: whether a model ranks churners well, whether that ranking earns more expected maximum profit (EMP), and whether its probabilities can drive a threshold policy. With a split-aware test and Holm correction over 20 pre-declared comparisons, TabPFN-3.5 earns significantly more EMP than the best tuned GBDT on Cell2Cell (1.9%) and Iranian (7.6%), and these two gains also hold against each of the three tuned GBDTs separately. On Orange it is ahead in all 10 splits (14.3%), but the gain is not significant after correction (Holm p = 0.155). signals.title: Embodied Science Agents: Making Embodied Experimental Design Learnable
signals.summary: arXiv:2611.12958v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in large models have accelerated AI for Science toward agentic science, where AI agents autonomously conduct scientific discovery. Realising this vision requires closing the loop between computational reasoning and physical experimentation, positioning self-driving laboratories (SDLs) as critical enablers. However, existing SDLs exhibit a fundamental paradox: foundation model integration has increased linguistic sophistication while severing physical grounding. By treating models as disembodied planners that output symbolic workflows for separate robotic systems, current architectures inherently block the development of embodied experimental intuition. We argue that overcoming this paradox requires embedding \emph{learnability} along three interdependent axes: cognitive learnability (learning what to investigate), experimental learnability (learning where to search), and embodied learnability (learning how to act). themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu chưa có thay đổi chính sách/luồng hàng thực tế hoặc mặt hàng liên quan không gắn với Việt Nam.

evidence.summary: arXiv:2611.12960v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Privacy-aware person re-identification (Re-ID) from top-view cameras replaces frontal appearance with anthropometric shape, while depth sensing further reduces color-based identity cues. The ICPR 2026 TVRID competition evaluates this setting using 86 identities captured by four synchronized Intel RealSense D455 cameras with RGB and Depth streams across flat, ascent, descent, and oblique viewpoints. evidence.title: LandslideFM: A Foundation Model Towards Unified Landslide Perception and Understanding
evidence.summary: arXiv:2611.12936v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Intelligent landslide detection is essential for disaster prevention. However, existing models primarily focus on isolated visual tasks, require extensive labeled data, and lack deep analytical and scene-understanding capabilities. themes.title: Việt Nam: chính sách và điều kiện kinh doanh
themes.reading: Chỉ đáng nâng thành tín hiệu khi có văn bản hoặc số liệu gốc, phạm vi áp dụng và nhóm chịu tác động xác định được. Tin kinh doanh đơn lẻ chưa đủ để kết luận xu hướng kinh tế Việt Nam.
themes.falsifier: Bác bỏ nếu không có văn bản/số liệu gốc hoặc nội dung không tạo thay đổi đáng kể với doanh nghiệp.

evidence.title: Đề xuất ưu đãi thuế với tàu thuyền không người lái
evidence.summary: Chính phủ đề xuất ưu đãi thuế cho tổ chức, cá nhân đóng mới, hoán cải tàu không người lái; miễn thuế thu nhập doanh nghiệp 5 năm với các dự án chuyển đổi xanh trong lĩnh vực hàng hải, đường thủy.

evidence.title: VN-Index tăng gần 30 điểm lên cao nhất nửa tháng
evidence.summary: VN-Index tăng vọt lên 1.743 điểm khi nhà đầu tư phản ứng tích cực với thông tin Ngân hàng Nhà nước bơm thanh khoản tiền đồng, góp phần giảm lãi suất.

evidence.title: Giá trị Nvidia bốc hơi hơn 400 tỷ USD vì bê bối của Jensen Huang
evidence.summary: Nhà đầu tư bán tháo cổ phiếu Nvidia, khiến vốn hóa sụt hơn 400 tỷ USD, còn Huang mất khoảng 15 tỷ USD sau hai phiên.
